_note: Japan edition (kreelz.com/jp) channels, collected by scripts/japan.mjs. Their videos are shown only on /jp. q = YouTube channel search used once to find the channel; title = the channel name must match this; min = minimum subscribers; korean = the channel also posts non-Korean content, keep only Korean titles; artist = Music priority artist the channel belongs to. id is filled in when found. not = reject channels whose name matches this. searched = last day a search found nothing (tried again after 7 days). ENHYPEN, TXT, LE SSERAFIM, BOYNEXTDOOR, ILLIT and TWS have no separate Japan channel (checked 2026-10-26): their Japanese releases are on the main channels. cat: screen = OTT (drama/film, shows and music by keywords), tv = Korean TV channel in Japan (same rules), music = an artist's channel.
